species.name: Victini
species.dex_text: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

species.name: Snivy
species.dex_text: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

species.name: Servine
species.dex_text: When it gets dirty, its leaves can't be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps clean. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage.

species.name: Serperior
species.dex_text: They raise their heads to intimidate foes, but only give it their all when fighting powerful opponents who are not fazed by the glare from its noble eyes.

species.name: Tepig
species.dex_text: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp. It blows fire through its nose.

species.name: Pignite
species.dex_text: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

species.name: Emboar
species.dex_text: It is adept at using many different moves. It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

species.name: Oshawott
species.dex_text: The scalchop on its stomach isn't just used for battle, it can be used to break open hard berries as well. It is made from the same element as its claws.

species.name: Dewott
species.dex_text: Strict training and disclipine leads it to master its flowing double-scalchop technique. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another.

species.name: Samurott
species.dex_text: One swing of the seamitars attached to its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them is enough to intimidate most enemies.

species.name: Patrat
species.dex_text: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days.

species.name: Watchog
species.dex_text: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

species.name: Lillipup
species.dex_text: It faces strong opponents with great courage. Because it doesn't yelp, it's extremely popular with Trainers who live in apartment buildings.

species.name: Herdier
species.dex_text: Its dense black fur grows continuously. The high cost of keeping its hard fur properly groomed makes this a troublesome Pokémon to train.

species.name: Stoutland
species.dex_text: Intelligent, good-natured, and valiant, there could be no concern that it would ever attack people. Some parents even trust it to babysit.

species.name: Purrloin
species.dex_text: Their deceptively cute act is the perfect ruse. They steal from people for fun, but their victims can't help but forgive them.

species.name: Liepard
species.dex_text: Many Trainers are drawn to their beautiful form and fur. These Pokémon vanish and appear unexpectedly. They run silently in the night.

species.name: Pansage
species.dex_text: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.

species.name: Simisage
species.dex_text: Ill tempered, it attacks enemies by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.

species.name: Pansear
species.dex_text: The fire within the tuft on its head can reach up to 600ºF. Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

species.name: Simisear
species.dex_text: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

species.name: Panpour
species.dex_text: The water stored inside the tuft of its head is rich in nutrients. It waters plants using its tail, plants that receive its water grow large.

species.name: Simipour
species.dex_text: It can shoot highly-pressurised water from its tail with enough power to break through a solid concrete wall. It prefers places with clean water.

species.name: Munna
species.dex_text: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams. Munna always float in the air.

species.name: Musharna
species.dex_text: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon. It changes into different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

species.name: Pidove
species.dex_text: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

species.name: Tranquill
species.dex_text: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it can always return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance.

species.name: Unfezant
species.dex_text: Males have plumage on their heads. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males. They will only let themselves feel close to their Trainers.

species.name: Blitzle
species.dex_text: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate with one another.

species.name: Zebstrika
species.dex_text: When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates. It is dangerous when it's angry as it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

species.name: Roggenrola
species.dex_text: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.

species.name: Boldore
species.dex_text: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks. When it is healthy, its core sticks out.

species.name: Gigalith
species.dex_text: The blasts of energy it makes from sunbeams have terrifying power. However, it's not able to fire its blasts at night or on rainy days.

species.name: Woobat
species.dex_text: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

species.name: Swoobat
species.dex_text: Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

species.name: Drilbur
species.dex_text: It can dig through the ground at a speed of 30 mph by spinning its body. It could give a car running aboveground a good race.

species.name: Excadrill
species.dex_text: More than 300 feet below the surface, they build mazelike nests. Their activity can be destructive to subway tunnels, but it can also help with construction.

species.name: Audino
species.dex_text: Its auditory sense is astounding. Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.

species.name: Timburr
species.dex_text: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs. As they grow, they carry bigger logs.

species.name: Gurdurr
species.dex_text: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.

species.name: Conkeldurr
species.dex_text: They use concrete pillars as walking canes. Rather than rely solely on force, they master moves that utilize the centrifugal force of spinning concrete.

species.name: Tympole
species.dex_text: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans. It uses the rhythm of these sounds to talk and warns others of danger.

species.name: Palpitoad
species.dex_text: It lives in the water and on land. When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

species.name: Seismitoad
species.dex_text: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. They can also shoot paralyzing liquid from their head bumps.

species.name: Throh
species.dex_text: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts. It changes belts as it gets more powerful.

species.name: Sawk
species.dex_text: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train. Disturbing their training angers them.

species.name: Sewaddle
species.dex_text: It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth. Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes, it is a mascot for fashion designers.

species.name: Swadloon
species.dex_text: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

species.name: Leavanny
species.dex_text: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to weave warm wrappings for Sewaddle by using the silk secreted from its mouth.

species.name: Venipede
species.dex_text: Using the feelers on its head and tail, it picks up vibrations in the air to determine its prey's location and state. It is brutally aggressive.

species.name: Whirlipede
species.dex_text: Storing energy for evolution, it sits. But when attacked, it spins its body at high speed like a wheel and then crashes furiously into its opponent.

species.name: Scolipede
species.dex_text: With quick movements, it chases down its foes, attacking relentlessly with its horns until it prevails. Then it finishes them off with deadly poison.

species.name: Cottonee
species.dex_text: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

species.name: Whimsicott
species.dex_text: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

species.name: Petilil
species.dex_text: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.

species.name: Lilligant
species.dex_text: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. It withers away if a trainer does not take good care of it.

species.name: Basculin
species.dex_text: It used to be a common food source. The meat of red Basculin is on the fatty side and it's more popular with the youth. Its temperament is vicious and aggressive.

species.name: Sandile
species.dex_text: It conceals itself in the sand and chomps down on the legs of any prey that unwarily walk over it. Its favorite food is Trapinch.

species.name: Krokorok
species.dex_text: They move in groups of a few individuals. Thanks to the special membrane covering its eyes, it can see its surroundings clearly, even in the dead of night.

species.name: Krookodile
species.dex_text: Very violent Pokémon, they never allow their prey to escape. Their jaws are so powerful, they can crush the body of an automobile.

species.name: Darumaka
species.dex_text: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it pulls its limbs into its body and falls asleep.

species.name: Darmanitan
species.dex_text: When one is injured in a fierce battle, it transforms into a stone statue. Then it meditates and sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

species.name: Maractus
species.dex_text: Arid regions are their habitat. When it moves rhythmically, it makes a sound similar to maracas, making the surprised Pokémon flee.

species.name: Dwebble
species.dex_text: It makes a hole in a stone of a suitable size. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.

species.name: Crustle
species.dex_text: Competing for territory, Crustle fight viciously. The one whose boulder is broken is the loser of the battle and begins to weaken.

species.name: Scraggy
species.dex_text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck. Its skull is massively thick.

species.name: Scrafty
species.dex_text: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. The one with the biggest crest is the group leader, and is the most respected.

species.name: Sigilyph
species.dex_text: The guardians of an ancient city, they always fly the same route while keeping watch for invaders. They use their psychic power to attack enemies.

species.name: Yamask
species.dex_text: These Pokémon arose from the spirits of people interred in graves in past ages. Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human.

species.name: Cofagrigus
species.dex_text: Grave robbers who mistake them for real coffins and get too close end up trapped inside their bodies. Their bodies are covered in pure gold.

species.name: Tirtouga
species.dex_text: Reputed to be the ancestor of most turtle Pokémon, it lived in warm seas about a hundred million years ago. It was restored from a fossil.

species.name: Carracosta
species.dex_text: They can live both in the ocean and on land. Incredible jaw strength enables them to chew up steel beams and rocks along with their prey.

species.name: Archen
species.dex_text: Said to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, Archen itself could not actually fly but moved by hopping from treetop to treetop.

species.name: Archeops
species.dex_text: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. When one Archeops had the prey cornered, another would swoop on it.

species.name: Trubbish
species.dex_text: It gorges on trash until its stomach is full. Then it belches toxic gas. An unlucky whiff of this gas will put a person in the hospital.

species.name: Garbodor
species.dex_text: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the full effects of this unidentified toxin.

species.name: Zorua
species.dex_text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

species.name: Zoroark
species.dex_text: Bonds between these Pokémon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents. They defend their lair with illusory scenery.

species.name: Minccino
species.dex_text: These Pokémon prefer a tidy habitat. They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

species.name: Cinccino
species.dex_text: Their white fur feels amazing to touch. Cinccino's body is coated in a special oil that repels dust and helps it deflect attacks, such as punches.

species.name: Gothita
species.dex_text: They intently observe both Trainers and Pokémon. Apparently, Gothita are looking at something that only they can see. Their ribbonlike feelers increase their power.

species.name: Gothorita
species.dex_text: Starlight is the source of their power. They use hypnosis to control people and Pokémon. Tales of Gothorita leading them astray are told in every corner.

species.name: Gothitelle
species.dex_text: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power. When it learns its Trainer's life span, it cries in sadness.

species.name: Solosis
species.dex_text: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they are fine in any environment, no matter how severe. They can use telepathy to talk with others.

species.name: Duosion
species.dex_text: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thoughts, these Pokémon exhibit their maximized psychic power.

species.name: Reuniclus
species.dex_text: They use psychic power to control their arms, which are made of a special liquid. When Reuniclus shake hands, a network forms between their brains.

species.name: Ducklett
species.dex_text: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.

species.name: Swanna
species.dex_text: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles. The one in the middle is the leader of the flock.

species.name: Vanillite
species.dex_text: The temperature of their breath is -58ºF. They create snow crystals and make snow fall in the areas around them. Vanillite is treasured by households in warm regions.

species.name: Vanillish
species.dex_text: Vanillish has existed since the Ice Age. It controls particles of ice, freezes its opponents, and then shatters them with a headbutt.

species.name: Vanilluxe
species.dex_text: Each of its two heads has a brain, and when they are in agreement, it attacks its enemies by exhaling a violent blizzard. It makes snow clouds inside its body.

species.name: Deerling
species.dex_text: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In early spring, these Pokémon give off a delicate, sweet, and calming scent.

species.name: Sawsbuck
species.dex_text: Some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring because the plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leader possesses magnificent horns.

species.name: Emolga
species.dex_text: It glides using its cape-like membrane. It grills berries and bug Pokémon with electric shocks from the pouches on its cheeks and makes a meal of them.

species.name: Karrablast
species.dex_text: When they feel threatened, they spit an acidic liquid to drive attackers away. For some reason they evolve while they are in the same place as Shelmet.

species.name: Escavalier
species.dex_text: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances. The steel armor protects their whole body.

species.name: Foongus
species.dex_text: It lures Pokémon in with its pattern that looks just like a Poké Ball, then releases its poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.

species.name: Amoonguss
species.dex_text: It lures prey close by dancing and waving its arm caps, which resemble Poké Balls, in a swaying motion, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.

species.name: Frillish
species.dex_text: If its veil-like arms stun and wrap an opponent, that foe will be dragged five miles below the surface to its lair, never to return.

species.name: Jellicent
species.dex_text: They propel themselves by expelling absorbed seawater from their bodies. It's said there's a castle of ships Jellicent have sunk on the seafloor.

species.name: Alomomola
species.dex_text: When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore. The special membrane enveloping Alomomola has the ability to heal wounds.

species.name: Joltik
species.dex_text: Since they can't generate their own electricity, they attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in a pouch.

species.name: Galvantula
species.dex_text: It creates barriers from electrified silk that stun foes. This works as a weapon as well as a defense. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

species.name: Ferroseed
species.dex_text: It absorbs the iron it finds in the rock while clinging to the ceiling of caves. When threatened, it attacks by shooting a barrage of spikes.

species.name: Ferrothorn
species.dex_text: It fights by swinging around its three spiky feelers and shooting spikes. A hit from these steel spikes can reduce a boulder to rubble.

species.name: Klink
species.dex_text: Two bodies comprise a fixed pair. The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

species.name: Klang
species.dex_text: A minigear and big gear comprise its body. Spinning minigears are rotated at high speed and repeatedly fired away. It is dangerous if the gears don't return.

species.name: Klinklang
species.dex_text: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It is rotated at high speed for a rapid energy charge. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

species.name: Tynamo
species.dex_text: These Pokémon move in schools. One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.

species.name: Eelektrik
species.dex_text: These Pokémon have a big appetite. It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

species.name: Eelektross
species.dex_text: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean, with their sucker mouths.

species.name: Elgyem
species.dex_text: It psychically squeezes the brain of its foe, causing unendurable headaches. Rumors of its origin are linked to a UFO crash site in the desert 50 years ago.

species.name: Beheeyem
species.dex_text: It can manipulate an opponent's memory. Apparently, it communicates by flashing its three fingers, but those patterns haven't been decoded.

species.name: Litwick
species.dex_text: While Litwick shines a light and pretends to be a guide, it absorbs the life force of any who follow it, which becomes the fuel that it burns.

species.name: Lampent
species.dex_text: This ominous Pokémon is feared. Through cities it wanders, searching for the spirits of the fallen. The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire.

species.name: Chandelure
species.dex_text: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.

species.name: Axew
species.dex_text: They mark their territory by leaving gashes in trees with their tusks. If a tusk breaks, a new one grows in quickly, harder and sturdier than the last.

species.name: Fraxure
species.dex_text: Their tusks can shatter rocks. A broken tusk will not grow back, so it diligently sharpens its tusks on river rocks after the end of a battle.

species.name: Haxorus
species.dex_text: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. Their sturdy tusks will stay sharp even if used to cut steel beams.

species.name: Cubchoo
species.dex_text: Its nose is always running. Their snot is a barometer of health. When healthy, their snot is sticky and the power of their ice moves increases.

species.name: Beartic
species.dex_text: It freezes its breath to create fangs and claws of ice to fight with. Very able in the water, it swims around in northern seas and catches prey.

species.name: Cryogonal
species.dex_text: They are born in snow clouds. When its body temperature goes up, it turns into steam and vanishes. When its temperature lowers, it returns to ice.

species.name: Shelmet
species.dex_text: When attacked, it defends itself by closing the lid of its shell. It evolves when bathed in an electric-like energy along with Karrablast.

species.name: Accelgor
species.dex_text: When its body dries out, it weakens. So, to prevent dehydration, it wraps itself in layers of thin membrane. It is very light and fights with ninja-like movements.

species.name: Stunfisk
species.dex_text: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

species.name: Mienfoo
species.dex_text: They have mastered elegant combos. As they concentrate, their battle moves become swifter and more precise. What it lacks in power, it makes up for in quantity.

species.name: Mienshao
species.dex_text: They use the long fur on their arms as a whip to strike their opponents. Its arm attacks come with such rapidity that they cannot even be seen.

species.name: Druddigon
species.dex_text: It warms its body by absorbing sunlight with its wings. When its body temperature falls, it can no longer move. It uses its sharp claws to catch prey.

species.name: Golett
species.dex_text: These Pokémon are thought to have been created by the science of an ancient and mysterious civilization. It's been active for thousands of years.

species.name: Golurk
species.dex_text: Golurk were created to protect people and Pokémon by an ancient civilisation. Removing the seal on its chest makes its internal energy go out of control.

species.name: Pawniard
species.dex_text: Ignoring their injuries, groups attack by sinking the blades that cover their bodies into their prey. If battling dulls them, it sharpens them on stones by the river.

species.name: Bisharp
species.dex_text: This pitiless Pokémon commands a group of Pawniard to hound prey into immobility. It battles to become the boss, but will be driven from the group if it loses.

species.name: Bouffalant
species.dex_text: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

species.name: Rufflet
species.dex_text: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

species.name: Braviary
species.dex_text: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if it is injured. One can carry a car while flying.

species.name: Vullaby
species.dex_text: It can't fly yet and must wait until its wings have developed more. They guard their posteriors with bones that were gathered by Mandibuzz.

species.name: Mandibuzz
species.dex_text: They adorn themselves beautifully with bones. This is supposedly an effort to attract males, but no male Mandibuzz have ever been found.

species.name: Heatmor
species.dex_text: It draws in air through its tail, transforms it into fire, and uses it like a tongue. They burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

species.name: Durant
species.dex_text: Durant dig nests in mountains. Individuals each play different roles in driving Heatmor, their natural predator, away from their colony.

species.name: Deino
species.dex_text: Lacking sight, it's unaware of its surroundings, so it bumps into things and eats anything that moves. Approaching it carelessly is dangerous.

species.name: Zweilous
species.dex_text: After it has eaten up all the food in its territory, it moves on to another area. Whichever head eats more than the other gets to be the leader.

species.name: Hydreigon
species.dex_text: This brutal Pokémon travels the skies on its six wings. The heads on their arms do not have brains. They use all three heads to consume and destroy everything.

species.name: Larvesta
species.dex_text: This Pokémon was believed to have been born from the sun. It spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.

species.name: Volcarona
species.dex_text: When volcanic ash darkened the atmosphere, it appeared and saved Pokémon from freezing, Volcarona's fire provided a replacement for the sun.

species.name: Cobalion
species.dex_text: It has a body and heart of steel. This legendary Pokémon battled against humans to protect Pokémon. Its personality is calm and composed.

species.name: Terrakion
species.dex_text: Spoken of in legend, this Pokémon used its phenomenal power to destroy a castle in its effort to protect Pokémon that had lost their homes in a war among humans.

species.name: Virizion
species.dex_text: Its head sprouts horns as sharp as blades. Legends say this Pokémon used whirlwind-like movements to confound and swiftly cut its opponents.

species.name: Tornadus
species.dex_text: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power can blow entire houses away. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.

species.name: Thundurus
species.dex_text: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.

species.name: Reshiram
species.dex_text: This Pokémon appears in legends. It sends flames into the air from its tail, burning up everything around it. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.

species.name: Zekrom
species.dex_text: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with lightning. It has a generator that creates electricity in its tail. It assists those with strong ideals.

species.name: Landorus
species.dex_text: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, granting bountiful crops. It has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”

species.name: Kyurem
species.dex_text: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals. Its body became frozen when its energy leaked out.

species.name: Keldeo
species.dex_text: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers.

species.name: Meloetta
species.dex_text: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad. Many famous songs have been inspired by the tunes that Meloetta plays.

species.name: Genesect
species.dex_text: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock without any effort.

species.name: Chespin
species.dex_text: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock without any effort.

species.name: Quilladin
species.dex_text: They strengthen the sturdy shell covering their bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won't start fights, but will counterattack with sharp quills.

species.name: Chesnaught
species.dex_text: It shields its allies from danger with its own body. When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it can withstand a bomb blast.

species.name: Fennekin
species.dex_text: As it walks, it munches on a twig to fill itself with energy in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its roomy ears.

species.name: Braixen
species.dex_text: Braixen has a twig stuck in its tail. When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.

species.name: Delphox
species.dex_text: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future. It uses psychic power to incinerate its foes.

species.name: Froakie
species.dex_text: It protects its skin by covering its body in bubbles it secretes from its chest and back. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.

species.name: Frogadier
species.dex_text: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away. Frogadier's swiftness is unparalleled.

species.name: Greninja
species.dex_text: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars made of compressed water.

species.name: Bunnelby
species.dex_text: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly. Bunnelby dig the whole night through.

species.name: Diggersby
species.dex_text: With its powerful ears it reduces dense bedrock to rubble. It can be a big help at construction sites. When it's finished digging, it lounges about lazily.

species.name: Fletchling
species.dex_text: This amiable Pokémon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side. It's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.

species.name: Fletchinder
species.dex_text: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on any bewildered Pokémon that pop out of the grass.

species.name: Talonflame
species.dex_text: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.

species.name: Scatterbug
species.dex_text: Its pattern depends on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from frigid lands. It scatters toxic color scales in battle.

species.name: Spewpa
species.dex_text: Its pattern depends on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from frigid lands. It scatters toxic color scales in battle.

species.name: Vivillon
species.dex_text: Its pattern depends on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from frigid lands. It scatters toxic color scales in battle.

species.name: Litleo
species.dex_text: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokémon are quick to start a fight.

species.name: Pyroar
species.dex_text: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride. The females protect the pride's cubs. They viciously threaten any challenger.

species.name: Flabébé
species.dex_text: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.

species.name: Floette
species.dex_text: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.

species.name: Florges
species.dex_text: This Pokémon creates an impressive flower garden in its territory. It draws forth the power of the red flowers around its neck.

species.name: Skiddo
species.dex_text: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back. It has a placid disposition.

species.name: Gogoat
species.dex_text: It can tell how its trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathetic sense lets them run as if one being. They inhabit mountainous regions.

species.name: Pancham
species.dex_text: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.

species.name: Pangoro
species.dex_text: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.

species.name: Furfrou
species.dex_text: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself. The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears.

species.name: Espurr
species.dex_text: It has enough psychic energy to blast everything within 300 feet of itself. The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears.

species.name: Meowstic
species.dex_text: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

species.name: Honedge
species.dex_text: If anyone dares to grab its hilt, it wraps a blue cloth around that person's arm and drains that person's life energy completely.

species.name: Doublade
species.dex_text: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords. The complex attack patterns of its two swords are unstoppable, even against those skilled at swordplay.

species.name: Aegislash
species.dex_text: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.

species.name: Spritzee
species.dex_text: In the past, rather than using perfume, royal ladies carried a Spritzee that would waft a fragrance they liked. Its fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.

species.name: Aromatisse
species.dex_text: Its scent is so overpowering that, unless a Trainer happens to really enjoy the smell, he or she will have a hard time walking alongside it.

species.name: Swirlix
species.dex_text: Because it eats nothing but sweets, its fur is as sticky sweet as cotton candy. To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes sticky white threads.

species.name: Slurpuff
species.dex_text: Slurpuff can distinguish even the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

species.name: Inkay
species.dex_text: It flashes the light-emitting spots on its body, which drains its opponent's will to fight. It takes the opportunity to scuttle away and hide.

species.name: Malamar
species.dex_text: It lures prey close with hypnotic motions, then wraps its tentacles around it before finishing it off with digestive fluids. It forces others to do whatever it wants.

species.name: Binacle
species.dex_text: They stretch and then contract, yanking their rocks along with them in bold hops. They eat seaweed that washes up on the shoreline.

species.name: Barbaracle
species.dex_text: Barbaracle's legs and hands have minds of their own, and they will move independently. But they usually follow the head's orders.

species.name: Skrelp
species.dex_text: Camouflaged as rotten kelp, it hides from foes while storing up power for its evolution. They spray liquid poison on prey that approach unawares.

species.name: Dragalge
species.dex_text: Their poison is strong enough to eat through the hull of a tanker. Tales are told of ships that wander into seas where Dragalge live, never to return.

species.name: Clauncher
species.dex_text: Through controlled expulsions of internal gas, it can expel water like a pistol shot. At close distances, it can even shatter large rocks.

species.name: Clawitzer
species.dex_text: By expelling water from the nozzle in the back of its enormous claw, it can move at a speed of 60 knots. They launch cannonballs made of water.

species.name: Helioptile
species.dex_text: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their own energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

species.name: Heliolisk
species.dex_text: A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper. It can stimulate its muscles with electricity, boosting the strength in its legs.

species.name: Tyrunt
species.dex_text: Its immense jaws have enough destructive force that it can chew up a car. If something happens that it doesn't like, it throws a tantrum and runs wild.

species.name: Tyrantrum
species.dex_text: Thanks to its gargantuan jaws, which could shred thick metal plates as if they were paper, it was invincible in the ancient world it once inhabited.

species.name: Amaura
species.dex_text: This ancient Pokémon was restored from part of its body that had been frozen in ice for over 100 million years. It lived in a cold land where there were no predators.

species.name: Aurorus
species.dex_text: Using the diamond-shaped crystals on its body it can instantly create a wall of ice to block an opponent's attack, or encase them in ice.

species.name: Sylveon
species.dex_text: Its ribbonlike feelers give off an aura that weakens hostility in its prey, causing them to let down their guard. A moment later, it pounces.

species.name: Hawlucha
species.dex_text: With its wings, it controls its position in the air. Its proficient fighting skills enable it to keep up with big bruisers like Machamp and Hariyama.

species.name: Dedenne
species.dex_text: Its whiskers serve as antennas. By sending and receiving electrical waves, it can communicate with others over vast distances.

species.name: Carbink
species.dex_text: Born from the high temperatures and pressures deep underground, it defends itself by firing beams from the jewel part of its body.

species.name: Goomy
species.dex_text: Its source of protection is its slimy, germ-laden mucous membrane. Anyone who touches it will need some thorough hand-washing.

species.name: Sliggoo
species.dex_text: This Pokémon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.

species.name: Goodra
species.dex_text: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.

species.name: Klefki
species.dex_text: These key collectors threaten any attackers by fiercely jingling their keys at them. It will sneak into people's homes to steal their keys.

species.name: Phantump
species.dex_text: According to legend, medicine to cure any illness can be made by plucking the green leaves on its head, brewing them, and boiling down the liquid.

species.name: Trevenant
species.dex_text: Through its roots, it exerts control over other trees. A deadly curse falls upon anyone cutting down trees in forests where Trevenant dwell.

species.name: Pumpkaboo
species.dex_text: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.

species.name: Gourgeist
species.dex_text: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.

species.name: Bergmite
species.dex_text: It blocks opponents' attacks with the ice that shields its body. It uses cold air to repair any cracks with new ice. They live in herds on snowy mountains.

species.name: Avalugg
species.dex_text: The way several Bergmite huddle on its back make it look like an aircraft carrier made of ice. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

species.name: Noibat
species.dex_text: They live in pitch-black caves. Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.

species.name: Noivern
species.dex_text: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles.

species.name: Xerneas
species.dex_text: Legends say that when the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is sharing everlasting life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree

species.name: Yveltal
species.dex_text: When its life comes to an end, its wings and tail spread wide and glow red, and it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon.

species.name: Zygarde
species.dex_text: It's said to be monitoring the ecosystem from deep in the caves where it lives. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within its cells.

species.name: Diancie
species.dex_text: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world. It creates diamonds between its hands.

species.name: Hoopa
species.dex_text: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. When its powers are sealed away, it is transformed into a much smaller form. It teleports things to a secret place.

species.name: Volcanion
species.dex_text: It lets out billows of steam from the arms on its back and disappears into the dense fog. It's said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.

species.name: Rowlet
species.dex_text: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night. Silently it glides, drawing near to its target.

species.name: Dartrix
species.dex_text: A bit of a dandy, it spends its free time preening its wings. Its preoccupation with any dirt on its plumage can leave it unable to battle.

species.name: Decidueye
species.dex_text: Decidueye is cool and cautious. It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances of over a hundred yards.

species.name: Litten
species.dex_text: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

species.name: Torracat
species.dex_text: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.

species.name: Incineroar
species.dex_text: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

species.name: Popplio
species.dex_text: This Pokémon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.

species.name: Brionne
species.dex_text: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance with a sequence of water balloons  to try and help.

species.name: Primarina
species.dex_text: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

species.name: Pikipek
species.dex_text: This Pokémon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth. It uses holes in trees for nesting.

species.name: Trumbeak
species.dex_text: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors. It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak.

species.name: Toucannon
species.dex_text: When it battles, within its beak, its internal gases ignite, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.

species.name: Yungoos
species.dex_text: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses and falls asleep on the spot.

species.name: Gumshoos
species.dex_text: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location... but as it's diurnal, it's always snoozing by nightfall.

species.name: Grubbin
species.dex_text: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokémon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokémon, though it normally lives underground.

species.name: Charjabug
species.dex_text: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

species.name: Vikavolt
species.dex_text: It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its foes. It overwhelms bird Pokémon with shocking beams of electrical energy.

species.name: Crabrawler
species.dex_text: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

species.name: Crabominable
species.dex_text: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew thick fur.

species.name: Oricorio
species.dex_text: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.

species.name: Cutiefly
species.dex_text: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers. It can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

species.name: Ribombee
species.dex_text: Ribombee rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle. They are sometimes sold as supplements.

species.name: Rockruff
species.dex_text: This Pokémon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.

species.name: Lycanroc
species.dex_text: It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey, then slices them with the rocks in its mane.

species.name: Wishiwashi
species.dex_text: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.

species.name: Mareanie
species.dex_text: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokémon.

species.name: Toxapex
species.dex_text: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.

species.name: Mudbray
species.dex_text: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire form its daily routine.

species.name: Mudsdale
species.dex_text: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.

species.name: Dewpider
species.dex_text: It crawls onto the land in search of food. When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokémon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.

species.name: Araquanid
species.dex_text: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokémon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.

species.name: Fomantis
species.dex_text: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.

species.name: Lurantis
species.dex_text: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

species.name: Morelull
species.dex_text: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.

species.name: Shiinotic
species.dex_text: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

species.name: Salandit
species.dex_text: It burns its bodily fluids to create a sweet-smelling poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

species.name: Salazzle
species.dex_text: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit to live with. Its poisonous gas is filled with pheromones.

species.name: Stufful
species.dex_text: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling. It's an incredibly dangerous Pokémon.

species.name: Bewear
species.dex_text: This Pokémon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.

species.name: Bounsweet
species.dex_text: A delectable aroma pours from its body.  Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.

species.name: Steenee
species.dex_text: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokémon, this Pokémon is totally fine.

species.name: Tsareena
species.dex_text: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

species.name: Comfey
species.dex_text: It attaches flowers to its nutritious vine. Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokémon is a hit with many people.

species.name: Oranguru
species.dex_text: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokémon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.

species.name: Passimian
species.dex_text: They battle with hard berries for weapons. They form groups of about 20 individuals. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.

species.name: Wimpod
species.dex_text: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake. It lives on beaches and seabeds.

species.name: Golisopod
species.dex_text: It battles skillfully with its six arms, with a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater--or even air--right in two.

species.name: Sandygast
species.dex_text: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth, to add to the pile of its sand-mound body. This Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

species.name: Palossand
species.dex_text: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

species.name: Pyukumuku
species.dex_text: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. The sticky mucous that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!

species.name: Type: Null
species.dex_text: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokémon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its capabilities. It has some hidden special power.
