species.name: Silvally
species.dex_text: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

species.name: Minior
species.dex_text: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

species.name: Komala
species.dex_text: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

species.name: Turtonator
species.dex_text: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point. It gushes fire from its nostrils.

species.name: Togedemaru
species.dex_text: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

species.name: Mimikyu
species.dex_text: A lonely Pokémon, it hides its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokémon. Its actual appearance is unknown.

species.name: Bruxish
species.dex_text: It stuns its prey with its psychic powers and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.

species.name: Drampa
species.dex_text: This Pokémon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.

species.name: Dhelmise
species.dex_text: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokémon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.

species.name: Jangmo-o
species.dex_text: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o live. They grow little by little battling one another.

species.name: Hakamo-o
species.dex_text: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder each time they're regrown. Its scaly punches tear its foes to shreds.

species.name: Kommo-o
species.dex_text: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other valuable commodities.

species.name: Tapu Koko
species.dex_text: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.

species.name: Tapu Lele
species.dex_text: A fragrant aroma of flowers follows it. As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health.

species.name: Tapu Bulu
species.dex_text: It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth. It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around at its enemies.

species.name: Tapu Fini
species.dex_text: People say it can create pure water that will wash away any corruption. The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies.

species.name: Cosmog
species.dex_text: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokémon from another world, but no specific details are known.

species.name: Cosmoem
species.dex_text: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell.

species.name: Solgaleo
species.dex_text: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

species.name: Lunala
species.dex_text: When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world. This Pokémon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.

species.name: Nihilego
species.dex_text: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. It's unclear whether or not this Pokémon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.

species.name: Buzzwole
species.dex_text: This life-form called an Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

species.name: Pheromosa
species.dex_text: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.

species.name: Xurkitree
species.dex_text: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

species.name: Celesteela
species.dex_text: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. One kind of Ultra Beast, witnesses saw it flying across the sky by expelling gas from its two arms.

species.name: Kartana
species.dex_text: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

species.name: Guzzlord
species.dex_text: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. But for some reason its droppings have never been found.

species.name: Necrozma
species.dex_text: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

species.name: Magearna
species.dex_text: This artificial Pokémon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.

species.name: Marshadow
species.dex_text: Able to conceal itself in the shadows of others, it never appears before humans, so its very existence is the stuff of myth. This Pokémon is craven and cowering.

species.name: Poipole
species.dex_text: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

species.name: Naganadel
species.dex_text: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

species.name: Stakataka
species.dex_text: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life- forms stacked one on top of each other.

species.name: Blacephalon
species.dex_text: It slithers toward people and explode its head without warning. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

species.name: Zeraora
species.dex_text: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.

species.name: Meltan
species.dex_text: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

species.name: Melmetal
species.dex_text: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

species.name: Grookey
species.dex_text: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

species.name: Thwackey
species.dex_text: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

species.name: Rillaboom
species.dex_text: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

species.name: Scorbunny
species.dex_text: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

species.name: Raboot
species.dex_text: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

species.name: Cinderace
species.dex_text: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

species.name: Sobble
species.dex_text: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

species.name: Drizzile
species.dex_text: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

species.name: Inteleon
species.dex_text: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

species.name: Skwovet
species.dex_text: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

species.name: Greedent
species.dex_text: It stashes berries in its tail--so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

species.name: Rookidee
species.dex_text: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle--even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

species.name: Corvisquire
species.dex_text: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

species.name: Corviknight
species.dex_text: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

species.name: Blipbug
species.dex_text: A constant collector of information, this Pokémon is very smart. Very strong is what it isn't.

species.name: Dottler
species.dex_text: It barely moves, but it's still alive. Hiding in its shell without food or water seems to have awakened its psychic powers.

species.name: Orbeetle
species.dex_text: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

species.name: Nickit
species.dex_text: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.

species.name: Thievul
species.dex_text: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

species.name: Gossifleur
species.dex_text: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.

species.name: Eldegoss
species.dex_text: The seeds attached to its cotton fluff are full of nutrients. It spreads them on the wind so that plants and other Pokémon can benefit from them.

species.name: Wooloo
species.dex_text: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.

species.name: Dubwool
species.dex_text: Weave a carpet from its springy wool, and you end up with something closer to a trampoline. You'll start to bounce the moment you set foot on it.

species.name: Chewtle
species.dex_text: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

species.name: Drednaw
species.dex_text: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

species.name: Yamper
species.dex_text: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

species.name: Boltund
species.dex_text: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.

species.name: Rolycoly
species.dex_text: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

species.name: Carkol
species.dex_text: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

species.name: Coalossal
species.dex_text: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Applin
species.dex_text: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

species.name: Flapple
species.dex_text: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

species.name: Appletun
species.dex_text: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.

species.name: Silicobra
species.dex_text: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

species.name: Sandaconda
species.dex_text: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

species.name: Cramorant
species.dex_text: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

species.name: Arrokuda
species.dex_text: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

species.name: Barraskewda
species.dex_text: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

species.name: Toxel
species.dex_text: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.

species.name: Toxtricity
species.dex_text: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

species.name: Sizzlipede
species.dex_text: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.

species.name: Centiskorch
species.dex_text: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

species.name: Clobbopus
species.dex_text: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.

species.name: Grapploct
species.dex_text: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.

species.name: Sinistea
species.dex_text: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.

species.name: Polteageist
species.dex_text: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.

species.name: Hatenna
species.dex_text: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

species.name: Hattrem
species.dex_text: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.

species.name: Hatterene
species.dex_text: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

species.name: Impidimp
species.dex_text: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.

species.name: Morgrem
species.dex_text: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.

species.name: Grimmsnarl
species.dex_text: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.

species.name: Obstagoon
species.dex_text: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout--this move is known as Obstruct.

species.name: Perrserker
species.dex_text: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.

species.name: Cursola
species.dex_text: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.

species.name: Sirfetch'd
species.dex_text: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.

species.name: Mr. Rime
species.dex_text: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.

species.name: Runerigus
species.dex_text: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.

species.name: Milcery
species.dex_text: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.

species.name: Alcremie
species.dex_text: It launches swarms of missiles, each made of cream and loaded with 100,000 kilocalories. Get hit by one of these, and your head will swim.

species.name: Falinks
species.dex_text: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.

species.name: Pincurchin
species.dex_text: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.

species.name: Snom
species.dex_text: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.

species.name: Frosmoth
species.dex_text: Icy scales fall from its wings like snow as it flies over fields and mountains. The temperature of its wings is less than -290 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Stonjourner
species.dex_text: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.

species.name: Eiscue
species.dex_text: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

species.name: Indeedee
species.dex_text: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

species.name: Morpeko
species.dex_text: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

species.name: Cufant
species.dex_text: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

species.name: Copperajah
species.dex_text: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

species.name: Dracozolt
species.dex_text: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.

species.name: Arctozolt
species.dex_text: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.

species.name: Dracovish
species.dex_text: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.

species.name: Arctovish
species.dex_text: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

species.name: Duraludon
species.dex_text: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

species.name: Dreepy
species.dex_text: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

species.name: Drakloak
species.dex_text: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.

species.name: Dragapult
species.dex_text: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.

species.name: Zacian
species.dex_text: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokémon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

species.name: Zamazenta
species.dex_text: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

species.name: Eternatus
species.dex_text: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

species.name: Kubfu
species.dex_text: Kubfu trains hard to perfect its moves. The moves it masters will determine which form it takes when it evolves.

species.name: Urshifu
species.dex_text: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit KO. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

species.name: Zarude
species.dex_text: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.

species.name: Regieleki
species.dex_text: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.

species.name: Regidrago
species.dex_text: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.

species.name: Glastrier
species.dex_text: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It's also a belligerent Pokémon-- anything it wants, it takes by force.

species.name: Spectrier
species.dex_text: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one--it doesn't use its sense of sight. Spectrier's kicks are said to separate soul from body.

species.name: Calyrex
species.dex_text: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

species.name: Wyrdeer
species.dex_text: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when it is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat and is useful for winter clothing.

species.name: Kleavor
species.dex_text: A violent creature that fells trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. Should one encounter this Pokémon in the wild, one's only recourse is to flee.

species.name: Ursaluna
species.dex_text: Swampy terrain gives Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

species.name: Basculegion
species.dex_text: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species in all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

species.name: Sneasler
species.dex_text: Because of its wicked poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on frozen highlands. It prefers solitude and doesn't form packs.

species.name: Overqwil
species.dex_text: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname “Sea Fiend”. It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

species.name: Enamorus
species.dex_text: Its arrival brings an end to the winter. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across the land.

species.name: Sprigatito
species.dex_text: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

species.name: Floragato
species.dex_text: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

species.name: Meowscarada
species.dex_text: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.

species.name: Fuecoco
species.dex_text: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco's head and flickers to and fro.

species.name: Crocalor
species.dex_text: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

species.name: Skeledirge
species.dex_text: Skeledirge's gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Quaxly
species.dex_text: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

species.name: Quaxwell
species.dex_text: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

species.name: Quaquaval
species.dex_text: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

species.name: Lechonk
species.dex_text: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn't use it for anything other than foraging.

species.name: Oinkologne
species.dex_text: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

species.name: Tarountula
species.dex_text: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread's strength is the topic of ongoing research.

species.name: Spidops
species.dex_text: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

species.name: Nymble
species.dex_text: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.

species.name: Lokix
species.dex_text: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.

species.name: Pawmi
species.dex_text: The pads of its paws are electricity- discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

species.name: Pawmo
species.dex_text: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.

species.name: Pawmot
species.dex_text: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.

species.name: Tandemaus
species.dex_text: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.

species.name: Maushold
species.dex_text: The little one just appeared one day. They all live together like a family, but the relationship between the three is still unclear.

species.name: Fidough
species.dex_text: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough's breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon's vicinity.

species.name: Dachsbun
species.dex_text: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon's body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.

species.name: Smoliv
species.dex_text: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

species.name: Dolliv
species.dex_text: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh- scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.

species.name: Arboliva
species.dex_text: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

species.name: Squawkabilly
species.dex_text: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they're out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

species.name: Nacli
species.dex_text: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli's body.

species.name: Naclstack
species.dex_text: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

species.name: Garganacl
species.dex_text: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.

species.name: Charcadet
species.dex_text: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.

species.name: Armarouge
species.dex_text: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.

species.name: Ceruledge
species.dex_text: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.

species.name: Tadbulb
species.dex_text: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.

species.name: Bellibolt
species.dex_text: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly- button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

species.name: Wattrel
species.dex_text: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.

species.name: Kilowattrel
species.dex_text: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

species.name: Maschiff
species.dex_text: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

species.name: Mabosstiff
species.dex_text: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

species.name: Shroodle
species.dex_text: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

species.name: Grafaiai
species.dex_text: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

species.name: Bramblin
species.dex_text: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.

species.name: Brambleghast
species.dex_text: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.

species.name: Toedscool
species.dex_text: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

species.name: Toedscruel
species.dex_text: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.

species.name: Klawf
species.dex_text: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.

species.name: Capsakid
species.dex_text: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.

species.name: Scovillain
species.dex_text: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

species.name: Rellor
species.dex_text: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.

species.name: Rabsca
species.dex_text: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.

species.name: Flittle
species.dex_text: Flittle's toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon's belly.

species.name: Espathra
species.dex_text: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

species.name: Tinkatink
species.dex_text: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.

species.name: Tinkatuff
species.dex_text: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.

species.name: Tinkaton
species.dex_text: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

species.name: Wiglett
species.dex_text: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.

species.name: Wugtrio
species.dex_text: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

species.name: Bombirdier
species.dex_text: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

species.name: Finizen
species.dex_text: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

species.name: Palafin
species.dex_text: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

species.name: Varoom
species.dex_text: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

species.name: Revavroom
species.dex_text: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders- now numbering eight-to generate energy.

species.name: Cyclizar
species.dex_text: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider's body heat warms Cyclizar's back and lifts the Pokémon's spirit.

species.name: Orthworm
species.dex_text: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.

species.name: Glimmet
species.dex_text: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

species.name: Glimmora
species.dex_text: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

species.name: Greavard
species.dex_text: This friendly Pokémon doesn't like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

species.name: Houndstone
species.dex_text: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

species.name: Flamigo
species.dex_text: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

species.name: Cetoddle
species.dex_text: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.

species.name: Cetitan
species.dex_text: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

species.name: Veluza
species.dex_text: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

species.name: Dondozo
species.dex_text: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

species.name: Tatsugiri
species.dex_text: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.

species.name: Annihilape
species.dex_text: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.

species.name: Clodsire
species.dex_text: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It's a risky move that puts everything on the line.

species.name: Farigiraf
species.dex_text: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig's.

species.name: Dudunsparce
species.dex_text: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

species.name: Kingambit
species.dex_text: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it's not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

species.name: Great Tusk
species.dex_text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.

species.name: Scream Tail
species.dex_text: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

species.name: Brute Bonnet
species.dex_text: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

species.name: Flutter Mane
species.dex_text: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

species.name: Slither Wing
species.dex_text: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.

species.name: Sandy Shocks
species.dex_text: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

species.name: Iron Treads
species.dex_text: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

species.name: Iron Bundle
species.dex_text: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.

species.name: Iron Hands
species.dex_text: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.

species.name: Iron Jugulis
species.dex_text: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.

species.name: Iron Moth
species.dex_text: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.

species.name: Iron Thorns
species.dex_text: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.

species.name: Frigibax
species.dex_text: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

species.name: Arctibax
species.dex_text: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

species.name: Baxcalibur
species.dex_text: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

species.name: Gimmighoul
species.dex_text: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it's actually a Pokémon.

species.name: Gholdengo
species.dex_text: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

species.name: Wo-Chien
species.dex_text: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king's evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.

species.name: Chien-Pao
species.dex_text: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.

species.name: Ting-Lu
species.dex_text: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

species.name: Chi-Yu
species.dex_text: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

species.name: Roaring Moon
species.dex_text: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to Mega Evolution that occurs in Hoenn.

species.name: Iron Valiant
species.dex_text: It has some similarities to a mad scientist's invention covered in a paranormal magazine.

species.name: Koraidon
species.dex_text: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

species.name: Miraidon
species.dex_text: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an Violet Book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

species.name: Walking Wake
species.dex_text: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old journal.

species.name: Iron Leaves
species.dex_text: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

species.name: Dipplin
species.dex_text: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.

species.name: Poltchageist
species.dex_text: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.

species.name: Sinistcha
species.dex_text: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.

species.name: Okidogi
species.dex_text: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.

species.name: Munkidori
species.dex_text: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.

species.name: Fezandipiti
species.dex_text: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.

species.name: Ogerpon
species.dex_text: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging, and spouting pillars of flame.

species.name: Archaludon
species.dex_text: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.

species.name: Hydrapple
species.dex_text: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

species.name: Gouging Fire
species.dex_text: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging, and spouting pillars of flame.

species.name: Raging Bolt
species.dex_text: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranomal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

species.name: Iron Boulder
species.dex_text: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

species.name: Iron Crown
species.dex_text: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like Cobalion.

species.name: Terapagos
species.dex_text: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.

species.name: Pecharunt
species.dex_text: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt's control, chained to its will.
